title_en: God of War Laufey SDCC Panel Live Report | Comic Con 2026
summary_en: IGN’s live reporting of San Diego Comic-Con 2026 continues, this time from the front row of the God of War Laufey panel.
body_en:
IGN’s live reporting of San Diego Comic-Con 2026 continues, this time from the front row of the God of War Laufey panel. The action kicks off on Friday, July 24, at 5.30pm PT / 8.30pm ET / July 25 1.30am UK time, and we’ll be there delivering you all the news via updates below.
We’re expecting God of War Laufey game director Ariel Lawrence and Santa Monica Studio head of creative Cory Barlog to lead an in-depth conversation with the cast, including Deborah Ann Woll (Laufey), Chris Judge (Kratos), Jack Quaid (Phranque), and Perlina Lau (Rue). Sony has said the panelists will share new details about the heroes of God of War Laufey, including behind-the-scenes insights from development and the performance capture that brings each character to life.
While you wait, check out all IGN’s exclusive coverage of God of War Laufey from its reveal in June. We have Lawrence and Barlog discussing why the developer went with Faye as the main character this time instead of Kratos, and we’ve got an explainer on Faye herself if you need a catch-up on her story.
Meanwhile, on Friday, July 24 and Saturday, July 25, IGN will stream live from San Diego with A-list interviews, exclusive reveals, and live coverage of SDCC’s biggest panels and announcements. Our broadcast runs from 3pm PT / 6pm ET to 7pm PT / 10pm ET each day and streams across IGN platforms. Here's our live show schedule .
Wesley is Director, News at IGN. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100. You can reach Wesley at wesley_yinpoole@ign.com or confidentially at wyp100@proton.me.
